free_tier.stated: CNY 0 free standing compute allowance is published: every sandbox instance gets 20 GiB of local storage free while it runs, and persistent storage has a free allowance of 10 GiB per account per month; compute is billed per second from 2026-11-19 at CNY 0.00002 per vCPU-second and CNY 0.00001 per GiB-second in the China (Yangzhou 1) region
free_tier.notes: The free allowance is a monthly persistent-storage volume plus local scratch space, not free sandbox runtime. The documentation for a different Qiniu AI inference product states a 24-hour verification-free trial period; that policy is not stated for the sandbox service and is not applied here.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a running sandbox, not a stored object; each instance receives 20 GiB of local storage free while it runs

retention.stated: the local filesystem is not kept after the sandbox terminates; persistent templates and snapshots survive while billed, and paused sandboxes are not documented here
retention.notes: unverified: no sandbox-specific retention period in days is published on the pages read

egress.terms: network traffic is not charged separately; the China (Yangzhou 1) region blocks outbound port 25 and inbound port 53 by default on full-stack servers

interface_detail: The sandbox service is fully E2B API compatible: an E2B SDK drives it with E2B_API_KEY and E2B_API_URL set for the chosen region; qshell is the command-line tool for sandbox, template and key-injection management.
tooling: The hosted sandbox service is reached with the E2B SDK (npm @e2b/code-interpreter or pip e2b-code-interpreter), which the user installs, and with qshell for command-line management; the account's API key comes from the Qiniu developer console.
chaining: An existing E2B client works by changing E2B_API_URL to a Qiniu regional endpoint, so agent code that already calls E2B can be pointed at the China or US region without a second SDK.

limits.value: 10 GiB of persistent storage per account per month free; excess is CNY 0.000145 per GiB-hour in China (Yangzhou 1) and CNY 0.00019575 per GiB-hour in the US (Dallas 1), rounded up to an hour
1 to 8 vCPU per sandbox and 512 MiB to 8192 MiB of memory in multiples of 512 MiB; each instance gets 20 GiB of local storage free
creating a sandbox needs a Qiniu account and an E2B_API_KEY; real-name verification requires a national ID by QR-code face scan, a bank-card check, or a small bank transfer

limits_note: unverified: the numeric RPM and TPM caps for unverified accounts are not published on the AI inference product's verification page and are not stated for the sandbox service
binding_note: The real-name check is the first constraint on a new account: creating a sandbox needs an API key from a Qiniu account, and personal verification requires a national ID or bank credential, while the monthly persistent-storage allowance is a volume that has to be exceeded to bind.

identity_cost.detail: A Qiniu account and an API key from the developer console are required. Personal verification offers a QR-code face scan with personal identity information, a bank-card check with a face photo, or a bank transfer of CNY 0.01 to 0.99 to the applicant's card with the amount returned; enterprise verification needs a business licence. A distinct Qiniu AI inference product grants a 24-hour verification-free trial, but no equivalent sandbox trial is published: unverified for the sandbox service.

reliability_note: Persistent storage keeps billing while a sandbox is not running; an account in arrears cannot create new sandboxes and running instances are released.
confidence_note: The per-second rates, the free persistent-storage allowance, the local storage, the network terms and the E2B-compatible endpoint come from the vendor's sandbox documentation pages read on 2026-11-24; the verification methods come from the vendor's account-finance documentation read the same day.

notes: Hosted E2B-compatible sandboxes in China (Yangzhou 1) and US (Dallas 1). The China vCPU and memory prices were cut by about 33.3% on 2026-11-19 to CNY 0.00002 per core-second and CNY 0.00001 per GiB-second; the US rates are CNY 0.0000405 and CNY 0.00002025. The persistent-storage allowance is 10 GiB per account per month free and network traffic carries no separate charge. A national-ID or bank verification gate applies to a Qiniu account.
